items.reason: A fragrance-free, active-free cleanser keeps skin fresh without stripping it.
Hyaluronic acid adds a hydrated, plumper look that can make dull-looking skin appear brighter.
A light ceramide moisturizer supports a smoother, more even-looking surface without feeling heavy on oily skin.
A mineral SPF 50 helps keep skin looking even and protects day to day, and mineral filters are a common choice during pregnancy.

response.routine_note: I've left out the 30% peel because strong at-home peels with high-strength acids aren't a good fit during pregnancy, so please check with your doctor or a dermatologist before using any exfoliating acid. Cleanse and moisturize morning and night, adding the hyaluronic serum before moisturizer and sunscreen as the last step each morning.
